verdict.rationale: Groq's docs position it as fast LLM inference, with service tiers to tune latency and throughput, a Flex tier for high-throughput workloads, and streaming of completion deltas. Independent hands-on reports corroborate high generation throughput (~450–491 tokens/s on Mixtral, ~200 tps on Llama 2 70B), and Groq staff describe batch-size-1 throughput with no queuing. One user calls performance poor for the token price, but this is vague and is not a concrete contradiction of the speed claims. Missing for 10: no explicit time-to-first-token measurements or first-party latency figures, and the hands-on throughput reports cover older models only.
